events.detail: The order #order-1045 was damaged and the damage policy allows either a refund or replacement with human approval. However, a final-sale promotion conflicts with this damage policy. According to the conflicting policies rule, such cases must be escalated for human review before any refund or replacement can be proposed.

evidence.content: Verified damaged orders may receive one refund up to the remaining paid amount OR one replacement. Never both. Human approval is mandatory.
evidence.title: Damaged goods

evidence.content: Delivery address may change only while the order is processing. A reviewer must approve the exact new address.
evidence.title: Address changes

evidence.content: A delay alone does not authorize a refund. Report the known shipment status. Escalate uncertainty, never invent delivery dates.
evidence.title: Delivery delays

evidence.content: When the final-sale promotion conflicts with damage policy, escalate for human review. Do not propose a refund until conflict is resolved.
evidence.title: Conflicting policies
